verdict.rationale: Salv Cases documents the grouping half of the story well. Analysts open a case, attach related alerts, customers and transactions, and work it with notes, documents, an assignee and a status. The case then appears on every customer, counterparty, payment and alert it touches. Alert prioritization is not explicitly documented; the evidence shows only triage-adjacent features: clearance rules that auto-close alerts, a suppression interval, good-listing of cleared matches, alert status updates, and person risk factors. Missing for 10: an explicit alert prioritization or ranking capability (e.g. priority scoring or risk-based queue ordering), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the case workflow.
